description: This file is a configuration class for a Spring Boot application, setting up Swagger documentation via Docket bean and API info.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that enables Swagger 2 and provides a Docket bean for API documentation setup.

methods.name: api()
methods.description: Defines and returns a Docket bean configured for Swagger 2, including API info and path selection.

methods.name: apiInfo()
methods.description: Creates and returns an ApiInfo object with title, description, and version for API documentation.
